content: Scraped news = untrusted content => indirect prompt injection (IPI). Embedded instructions in webpages/news can hijack LLM. OWASP + dual-LLM pattern: privileged LLM holds tools/never reads untrusted text; quarantined LLM reads untrusted content but cannot act. Structured/JSON-schema output is harder to inject than free text but NOT a full defense. Least privilege: LLM emits a signal, not order params; execution layer validates ticker/qty independently. Render untrusted news as reference-only, delimit clearly.
